jobs.title: Director, People Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Director, People Systems will own the strategy, architecture, and ongoing evolution of ClickHouse’s global people systems ecosystem, with Workday at its core. This role will serve as the senior subject matter expert and strategic partner for People systems, ensuring our technology, data, and processes scale with the organization.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role with significant ownership and autonomy. While the role will not initially have direct reports, the Director will lead cross-functional initiatives, manage external partners, establish systems governance, and influence People technology decisions across the organization.

What you will do:

  • Own the global People Systems strategy and roadmap, with Workday serving as the core HR platform

  • Lead the design, configuration, optimization, and ongoing evolution of Workday across modules including Core HCM, Compensation, Benefits, Payroll, Absence, and Time Tracking

  • Establish systems architecture, governance, security, data integrity, and change management standards across the People technology ecosystem

  • Partner with People, Finance, IT, Security, and business leaders to translate organizational needs into scalable technology solutions

  • Lead Workday releases, enhancements, integrations, testing, and adoption of new functionality

  • Own the strategy and governance for integrations between Workday and other internal and external systems

  • Drive the evolution of People data, reporting, and analytics capabilities to support business and workforce decision-making

  • Evaluate the People technology landscape and recommend investments, enhancements, and consolidation opportunities

  • Identify and implement opportunities for automation and AI to improve People processes, data quality, and employee experience

  • Manage external vendors, consultants, and implementation partners and ensure effective delivery against business priorities

  • Establish scalable processes and documentation that support a growing global organization

  • Serve as the senior escalation point and subject matter expert for complex People Systems issues

What you bring along:

  • 10+ years of experience in HRIS / People Systems, with significant ownership of Workday in a complex or global organization

  • Deep Workday expertise and experience leading or playing a significant leadership role in at least one full-cycle Workday implementation

  • Strong understanding of Workday architecture, configuration, integrations, security, reporting, and data governance

  • Experience developing and executing a People Systems strategy and roadmap

  • Experience scaling People technology within a high-growth, global organization

  • Strong understanding of HR processes and the intersection between People, Payroll, Benefits, Finance, and IT systems

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders without direct authority

  • Strong vendor and implementation-partner management experience

  • Ability to operate both strategically and hands-on, particularly while building out the People Systems function

Bonus points for:

  • Workday certifications

  • Experience across multiple Workday modules

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Architect-Greater China Region
jobs.descriptionHtml:
• The Role

    As an Enterprise Solutions Architect at ClickHouse, you'll own the technical side of the sales cycle for enterprise accounts across Greater China. You'll engage with data platform engineers, architects, SRE, and the VP who owns the standard — and your job is to design something that satisfies all of them and then prove it at production scale.

    This is a role for engineers who want the hard version of the problem: real scale, real constraints, and an incumbent to displace. Prior pre-sales experience helps but isn't required — technical depth is non-negotiable.

    What You Will Be Doing

    • Own the technical evaluation for enterprise accounts across Greater China — from discovery through POC or competitive bake-off, architecture sign-off, security review, and first production workload.

    • Engage across a wider set of stakeholders than a single team: data platform engineers, architects, SRE, security, and the executive who owns the standard. Design solutions that hold up with all of them in the room.

    • Design for production scale — sizing, sharding and replication strategy, ingestion topology, tiered storage, cost modeling, and what happens when something fails at 3am.

    • Win competitive displacements against Elasticsearch, Splunk, Snowflake, BigQuery, Druid, Pinot, and homegrown systems, using benchmarks the customer's own team can reproduce.

    • Own the migration plan — sequencing, dual-run, validation, and cutover — so the customer's team can see exactly how they get to production.

    • Clear the security and procurement path: questionnaires, compliance artifacts, network and identity architecture, data residency requirements, and BYOC or private deployment requirements.

    • Partner closely with Enterprise AEs to progress and close opportunities — you own the technical win, they own the commercial close. Build the TCO case against the incumbent/competition together.

    • Advocate for customer needs internally with Product and Engineering — you're the voice of the technical buyer inside ClickHouse.

    • Contribute reference architectures, benchmark harnesses, migration guides, and objection handling material that help the team scale what's working.

    What You Bring

    • Professional fluency in Mandarin and English, written and verbal. You can run a deep technical workshop in Mandarin and represent the same architecture to a global internal audience in English.

    • Deep technical foundation in data infrastructure — built through experience as a data engineer, platform engineer, software engineer, DBA, or solutions architect.

    • Production experience with analytical databases (ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Druid, Pinot, Vertica) and with operating them, not just querying them.

    • Distributed systems judgment: partitioning, replication, consistency trade-offs, query execution, and a felt sense for where things break under load.

    • Fluency across the modern data stack — Kafka and CDC pipelines, orchestration, object storage, BI tools, and at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud) at architecture level.

    • Experience running a technical evaluation against a named competitor and winning it, including designing the migration off the incumbent and the parts of it that are genuinely hard.

    • Customer-facing experience with real stakes — pre-sales, consulting, technical account management, or a staff-level engineering role that put you in front of customers.

    • Strong written and verbal communication. You can whiteboard with a staff engineer in the morning and present to a VP of Engineering in the afternoon.

    • Comfort with longer cycles and more stakeholders. Enterprise evaluations don't close in three weeks, and you know how to keep one moving without letting it stall.

    • Willingness to say ClickHouse isn't the right tool for a given workload when that's true.

    Bonus Points for:

    • Experience selling or supporting technical sales into the Greater China market

    • Familiarity with the local cloud and data ecosystem (Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud) and how enterprises there build around it.

    • Open source community experience, including engaging developer and engineering audiences in the region.

    • Experience effectively working remotely in a global, distributed organization..

#LI-VR1

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive-San Francisco
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

You'll own a mostly greenfield enterprise territory and have a core focus on generating new logos

New business usually starts with a team already running ClickHouse — open source, or a Cloud account someone expensed — until a bill or a security review pushes the conversation up to the platform team and the budget owner. Common triggers: an Elasticsearch or Splunk bill that's hard to defend, a warehouse that can't serve a customer-facing feature fast enough, an AI product querying tens of billions of rows.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle for both new and existing accounts in your territory — first conversation through security review, procurement, and close, on Cloud commitments and multi-year committed spend.

  • Grow your install base by landing new teams and new use cases inside accounts that already buy from us.

  • Own renewals and consumption commitments, working with your Solutions Architect and Support to get ahead of usage and churn risk.

  • Watch consumption trends across your accounts and engage early when usage flattens or spikes. Both are signals.

  • Find and convert existing ClickHouse usage in new accounts. Unmanaged open-source deployments and self-serve Cloud accounts are the highest-yield source of new pipeline in this segment.

  • Multi-thread across the data platform team, the budget owner, security, and the executive sponsor rather than relying on a single champion.

  • Work with your Solutions Architect through the technical evaluation. They own the technical win, you own the commercial strategy and the close.

  • Run the procurement path: security questionnaires, legal redlines, vendor onboarding, and BYOC or private-deployment requirements.

  • Give your champion the internal business case — TCO comparison against the incumbent, migration plan, and risk mitigation.

  • Map the remaining teams and use cases in each account and build an expansion plan against them.

  • Keep Salesforce accurate and submit a forecast leadership can plan against, across both new business and expansion.

  • Participate in the developer community in your territory: meetups, conferences, and events.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years selling technical infrastructure to enterprise buyers — databases, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, observability, or developer tooling.

  • A track record closing complex deals that went through security review, legal, and procurement.

  • Enough technical fluency to hold an architecture conversation. You don't need to write SQL, but you should be able to explain why a company moves a workload off Elasticsearch.

  • Experience carrying a hybrid quota — new business alongside expansion and renewal — and the discipline to work both rather than defaulting to whichever is easier that quarter.

  • Experience with consumption-based or usage-metered commercial models, where revenue moves with usage between contract events.

  • Experience selling into developer-led, bottom-up adoption as well as top-down.

  • Ability to orchestrate people who don't report to you — Solutions Architects, executive sponsors, partners, product managers.

  • Accurate forecasting, including when the number is bad.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Postgres
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Managed Postgres team

The Managed Postgres team is building a high-performance, reliable PostgreSQL service within ClickHouse Cloud. We give developers a familiar PostgreSQL experience, remove operational burden, and connect transactional Postgres workloads with real-time analytics in ClickHouse. The team owns provisioning, high availability, backup and recovery, upgrades, observability, performance, security, and developer experience.

About the role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team building and operating ClickHouse Managed Postgres. You will combine people leadership, technical direction, product thinking, and operational ownership while maintaining the reliability customers expect.

You will report directly to Kaushik Iska, who leads the Managed Postgres organization. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Infrastructure, Security, Support, and engineering teams across ClickHouse.

What you will do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a high-performing team through clear expectations, feedback, development, and direct performance management.

  • Own outcomes across provisioning, fleet management, failover, point-in-time recovery, upgrades, observability, performance, and security.

  • Turn customer and business needs into a multi-quarter roadmap with incremental milestones.

  • Guide architecture and help senior engineers make explicit, sound tradeoffs.

  • Raise operational quality across SLOs, on-call, incidents, maintenance, and automation.

  • Work directly with customers and turn recurring pain into product improvements.

  • Align dependencies, surface risks early, and keep execution predictable across a distributed organization.

  • Hire the right mix of PostgreSQL, systems, infrastructure, reliability, and product engineering talent while fostering ownership and clear technical debate.

What you bring

  • 8+ years in software engineering, including 3+ years managing engineers in infrastructure, databases, or developer platforms.

  • Experience building and operating a customer-facing stateful service with demanding availability, durability, security, and performance requirements.

  • Working knowledge of PostgreSQL or managed relational databases, including replication, WAL, high availability, recovery, upgrades, observability, or performance diagnosis.

  • Technical credibility to engage deeply in architecture and incidents without owning daily implementation.

  • A record of hiring, coaching, developing, and retaining engineers, including senior ICs.

  • Strong execution judgment across ambiguity, parallel workstreams, risk, and long-term system health.

  • A customer mindset, strong Product partnership, clear communication, and distributed-team leadership.

Nice to have

  • Managed PostgreSQL, relational database, or cloud control-plane leadership

  • PostgreSQL internals, extensions, replication, storage, performance, or database reliability depth

  • AWS, GCP, Azure, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, or multi-region experience

  • Experience taking infrastructure from early adoption through general availability

  • Open-source, technical writing, speaking, startup, or founder experience

Why this role

  • Shape a strategic product at the intersection of PostgreSQL and ClickHouse.

  • Lead a technical team where correctness, performance, reliability, and developer experience all matter.

  • Influence the product, roadmap, operating model, and customer outcomes.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI/ML
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is the fastest-growing database in the OLAP space, and AI is reshaping how developers and enterprises interact with their data. From ClickHouse Agents and AI Functions to the Remote MCP Server, LibreChat, and Langfuse, AI/ML capabilities are rapidly becoming a core pillar of the ClickHouse Cloud experience and a key growth vector for the platform.

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own core areas of our agentic analytics experience. You will work at the intersection of large language models, developer tooling, and high-performance analytics, shaping how organizations let agents query, reason over, and act on their data. This is a high-ownership role: you will drive products from discovery to launch with autonomy expanding as fast as you build confidence and context.

What will you do?

  • Roadmap Ownership: Own the roadmap for key surfaces of the agentic analytics portfolio, from discovery through launch and iteration, and ensure they are best-in-class in the analytics database space.

  • Customer Discovery: Talk to users constantly — developers, data engineers, and platform teams deploying agents against production data — and turn their feedback into crisp priorities.

  • Product Quality: Define and prioritize features that improve agent accuracy, latency, cost, and trust. Instrument the product with evals and observability (Langfuse) so that quality is measured.

  • Market & Competitive Intelligence: Track the competitive landscape and translate it into positioning, differentiation, and gaps to close.

  • Go-to-Market Partnership: Partner with marketing, sales, and developer relations on pricing, packaging, launch content, and field enablement.

  • Communication: Write clearly and often, including public-facing content that explains what we built and why.

What you bring along:

  • 3+ years of product management experience in developer tools, data infrastructure, or ML/AI products

  • Hands-on familiarity with LLMs and agentic workflows: you have built or shipped something with them

  • Comfort with SQL and analytical databases; you can query your own product data without waiting for someone else

  • Strong written communication and the ability to drive alignment across engineering, design, and go-to-market

  • You have a high level of ownership and a bias toward shipping: you scope pragmatically, cut ruthlessly, and iterate in public

  • You thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders

Nice to have

  • Experience with LLM observability, evals, or inference infrastructure

  • Experience pricing usage-based or token-based products

  • Prior work on open source products or with open source communities

  • Understanding of database systems and data processing pipelines, with ClickHouse experience being a significant plus

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is on a mission to grow a vibrant global user community and accelerate our journey as a cloud first company. We’re looking for a seasoned Account Executive to help expand our customer base and shape the future of ClickHouse adoption in the region.

Our ideal candidate brings both business acumen and technical depth, capable of guiding customers with specialized expertise to help them achieve their objectives and unlock the full value of ClickHouse.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Identify and nurture opportunities, build pipeline, and close short term Cloud monthly contracts, while simultaneously developing a strategic Enterprise business with complex sales cycles.

  • Evangelize ClickHouse’s vision and solutions to secure strategic commercial commitments.

  • Take a solution-based approach to selling, delivering clear business value for customers.

  • Champion the innovation behind ClickHouse Cloud, driving awareness and adoption.

  • Manage customer details, including use cases, timelines, and forecasting, within Salesforce.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive-South Bay
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Role

You'll own a mostly greenfield enterprise territory and have a core focus on generating new logos

New business usually starts with a team already running ClickHouse — open source, or a Cloud account someone expensed — until a bill or a security review pushes the conversation up to the platform team and the budget owner. Common triggers: an Elasticsearch or Splunk bill that's hard to defend, a warehouse that can't serve a customer-facing feature fast enough, an AI product querying tens of billions of rows.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the full sales cycle for both new and existing accounts in your territory — first conversation through security review, procurement, and close, on Cloud commitments and multi-year committed spend.

  • Grow your install base by landing new teams and new use cases inside accounts that already buy from us.

  • Own renewals and consumption commitments, working with your Solutions Architect and Support to get ahead of usage and churn risk.

  • Watch consumption trends across your accounts and engage early when usage flattens or spikes. Both are signals.

  • Find and convert existing ClickHouse usage in new accounts. Unmanaged open-source deployments and self-serve Cloud accounts are the highest-yield source of new pipeline in this segment.

  • Multi-thread across the data platform team, the budget owner, security, and the executive sponsor rather than relying on a single champion.

  • Work with your Solutions Architect through the technical evaluation. They own the technical win, you own the commercial strategy and the close.

  • Run the procurement path: security questionnaires, legal redlines, vendor onboarding, and BYOC or private-deployment requirements.

  • Give your champion the internal business case — TCO comparison against the incumbent, migration plan, and risk mitigation.

  • Map the remaining teams and use cases in each account and build an expansion plan against them.

  • Keep Salesforce accurate and submit a forecast leadership can plan against, across both new business and expansion.

  • Participate in the developer community in your territory: meetups, conferences, and events.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years selling technical infrastructure to enterprise buyers — databases, data platforms, cloud infrastructure, observability, or developer tooling.

  • A track record closing complex deals that went through security review, legal, and procurement.

  • Enough technical fluency to hold an architecture conversation. You don't need to write SQL, but you should be able to explain why a company moves a workload off Elasticsearch.

  • Experience carrying a hybrid quota — new business alongside expansion and renewal — and the discipline to work both rather than defaulting to whichever is easier that quarter.

  • Experience with consumption-based or usage-metered commercial models, where revenue moves with usage between contract events.

  • Experience selling into developer-led, bottom-up adoption as well as top-down.

  • Ability to orchestrate people who don't report to you — Solutions Architects, executive sponsors, partners, product managers.

  • Accurate forecasting, including when the number is bad.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

The Role

You'll own a hybrid enterprise territory: existing customers to grow and renew, plus net-new accounts to win.

In the install base, most growth comes from new teams inside an account that already buys from us. One team lands a workload, it works, and four other teams have a similar problem. Your job is finding them early and keeping the commercial relationship in step with the usage, including renewals and consumption commitments.

New business usually starts with a team already running ClickHouse — open source, or a Cloud account someone expensed — until a bill or a security review pushes the conversation up to the platform team and the budget owner. Common triggers: an Elasticsearch or Splunk bill that's hard to defend, a warehouse that can't serve a customer-facing feature fast enough, an AI product querying tens of billions of rows.



What You Will Be Doing

We are hiring talented Full Stack Software Engineers for our Control Plane team.

The team focuses on great user experience, seamless, automated, and scalable cloud infrastructure deployment, and lifecycle management.

We build and maintain the Cloud Console—a sophisticated web application that lets users manage organizational resources such as database services and user access, run queries through a powerful SQL IDE, explore data with interactive dashboards, and monitor system performance.

If you’re excited about creating robust cloud platforms, this team could be a great fit.

What will you do?

jobs.title: Release Engineer - Data Plane Internal Tooling and Productivity
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Release Team owns the safe, continuous delivery of ClickHouse Cloud, a managed database platform running tens of thousands of ClickHouse clusters. We are responsible for upgrading and maintaining those clusters at scale, building the internal tooling that makes it possible, and being the last line of defense when something doesn't go according to plan.

About the role

This role is an equal split between operational execution and software development. You are responsible for the operational side: coordinating and running upgrades, dealing with edge cases that don't fit the happy path, and keeping tens of thousands of clusters healthy in production. At the same time, you are building and constantly improving the systems that make the next rollout safer and more automated than the last. If you find satisfaction in both writing the playbook and executing it, including the messy parts, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Plan and execute rolling upgrades across tens of thousands of ClickHouse clusters, ensuring safety, correctness, and minimal customer impact

  • Own the full release pipeline: from pre-upgrade validation and staged rollouts to post-upgrade monitoring and incident response

  • Investigate and resolve production issues as part of a regular on-call rotation, including snowflake clusters and edge cases that automation can't yet handle

  • Build and improve the internal tooling and automation that makes large-scale database operations reliable and repeatable

  • Work closely with the core database and cloud infrastructure teams to identify operational pain points and turn them into solved problems

  • Support and educate other engineering teams using our internal tools

About you

  • 5+ years of experience operating stateful distributed systems in production, such as databases, message queues, or storage systems

  • Hands-on experience running upgrades or maintenance operations on live production data stores, at scale

  • Strong production debugging skills; you are comfortable digging into unfamiliar systems under pressure

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and Kubernetes

  • Software development experience in Go (or strong experience in another language and genuine willingness to learn) 

  • Experience with ClickHouse preferred (as a user, operator or contributor)

#LI-Remote

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

What You’ll Be Doing

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The ClickPipes Platform plays a critical role in driving the growth of our company and ensuring the success of our clients by seamlessly onboarding and integrating data from diverse data sources into ClickHouse. Working at a petabyte scale and in high-velocity environments, this role offers an exceptional opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, operate with significant autonomy, and make a measurable impact.

Working on ClickPipes offers the opportunity to operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, tackle ambiguous problems, and deliver features that are used by some of the most data-intensive companies in the world.

You can find some of the teams recent work highlighted in our blog:

  • Flexible Scaling and Monitoring in ClickPipes

  • MySQL CDC Connector for ClickPipes

  • The Evolution of ClickPipes

As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you’ll design and build complex, data-heavy user interfaces and own customer-facing workflows end-to-end. While this role has a strong frontend focus, engineers are expected to work comfortably across the whole stack, collaborating on backend services, APIs, and system integrations as needed. We’re looking for T-shaped engineers who bring deep frontend expertise while remaining pragmatic and effective beyond UI tasks.

What will you do?

  • Build scalable UI systems that handle large datasets, async operations, and real-time state changes

  • Own features end-to-end, from initial design through production launch and long-term maintenance

  • Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to deliver new features

  • Partner on API design and system contracts

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support ClickPipes in production, helping diagnose incidents, and mitigate issues

  • Take ownership of production quality, including monitoring, debugging, performance tuning, and reliability improvements

What you will bring:

  • 5+ years of experience building and shipping production full-stack applications

  • In-depth knowledge of web fundamentals (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, DOM, HTTP)

  • Solid experience in designing and building applications with React and TypeScript

  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) as part of a CI/CD workflow

  • Practical knowledge of backend systems, REST and/or GraphQL APIs, and service-oriented architecture

  • Great communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, async-friendly team

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with Go, Node, or other server-side languages

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform

  • Experience working on data-intensive products or platforms at scale

Why Join Us:

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology at the intersection of data engineering and cloud-native infrastructure.

  • Be part of a high-visibility team integral to the company’s success.

  • Operate with autonomy, ownership, and the ability to drive meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving space.

 
 

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Backend) - AI/ML
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. This includes the Agentic Data Stack, AI Functions, chDB, the in-Console copilot, and the AI/ML partnerships that distribute them — together with the shared components and expertise that let every other ClickHouse team ship AI in the surfaces they own. Our team is looking for highly skilled and experienced software engineers to join us, who will be responsible for designing, building, and operating the products that make ClickHouse the platform of choice for agents and data scientists.

What you will do

  • Feature Development: Design and implement AI-powered features across the full stack, from backend inference services to intuitive frontend interfaces within the ClickHouse Cloud platform.

  • API Architecture: Create robust, scalable APIs that connect ClickHouse's database capabilities with modern AI/ML inference systems and external/internal AI services.

  • Ecosystem Integrations: Implement and maintain integrations with the broader AI/ML ecosystem and standards, ensuring that ClickHouse as a technology works seamlessly with popular frameworks and tools.

  • Technical Integration: Integrate models into production systems with proper monitoring, versioning, observability, and evaluation.

  • Oncall: Participate in the daytime oncall rotation along with the rest of the team.

  • Developer Experience: Design and implement developer tools, SDKs, and documentation that enable users to leverage ClickHouse’s AI/ML capabilities.

What you will bring along

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in production environments

  • Exposure to working directly with AI/ML technologies

  • Backend development experience in TypeScript or Python, with a focus on API design and service architecture

  • A high level of ownership and can drive features from concept to production with minimal supervision

  • Ability to thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders

Nice to have

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Clickpipes (CDC/Streaming)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Note:. We are hiring for this role remotely in any country ClickHouse has a hiring presence.

About the Team

The ClickPipes - Database Integrations team builds the platform that enables real-time data replication from databases into ClickHouse at petabyte scale.

As a member of this team, you will be solving complex database-related challenges and distributed systems problems, such as understanding database internals to optimize snapshotting strategy, handling schema evolution during live replication, managing data type compatibility across systems, maintaining low end-to-end latency under unpredictable loads, and leveraging durable execution frameworks to ensure data consistency over unreliable networks. We work in the open — our database integrations are built on PeerDB, an open-source CDC platform we actively maintain and contribute to.

See some of our recent work:

  • ClickPipes for Postgres now supports failover replication slots

  • MongoDB CDC to ClickHouse with Native JSON Support

  • Under the Hood: Building MySQL Change Data Capture in ClickPipes

What You’ll Do:

  • Build data-intensive systems

    • Design and develop high-throughput integrations with databases (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB), data lakes (Iceberg, Delta Lake), and data warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake).

    • Handle edge cases in real-world production scenarios: unconventional database setups, internals of data types, database upgrades/failovers, large transactions, etc.

    • Design integration solutions to enable users to fully harness ClickHouse's performance and throughput.

    Own end-to-end reliability

    • Debug complex issues in production leveraging runtime diagnostics (e.g. pprof, parca) and observability tools (e.g. metrics, logging, tracing).

    • Build and improve infrastructure and tools to increase system reliability, reduce incident response time, and simplify/automate operations.

    • Write clear documentation, both publicly and internally.

    • Participate in on-call rotation.

    Drive product innovation

    • Work directly with customers to understand integration requirements and discover gaps in existing product.

    • Collaborate cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure operational efficiency.

    • Lead technical discussions and influence product roadmaps.

About You:

  • 5+ years of industry experience building data-intensive software solutions.

  • Proficient in Go, or experienced in systems programming with willingness to ramp up quickly in Go.

  • Cloud-native experience deploying and operating services on at least one major cloud platform (AWS/GCP/Azure).

  • Practical experience with Kubernetes.

  • Strong problem solver and solid production debugging skills.

  • Clear communication in writing (design docs, code review) and verbally (technical discussions, customer calls, incident response).

Bonus Points

  • Experience with database replication technologies (CDC, logical replication).

  • Experience with durable execution frameworks (Temporal).

  • Experience with data formats and protocols (Avro, Parquet, Protobuf).

  • Experience with modern data processing frameworks (e.g. Kafka, Spark, Flink).

  • Experience with maintaining/contributing to open-source software.

Why Join Us

  • Work on challenging problems at the intersection of database technologies, distributed systems, and cloud-native architecture.

  • Work on a team that builds software in the open (PeerDB), and that cares about the craft of engineering, documentations, and continuous learning.

  • Be part of a high-visibility team that delivers meaningful impact to customers in a dynamic, hyper-growth environment.

#LI-remote

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Workplaces
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is hiring a Sr. Manager, Global Workplaces to build our workplace function from the ground up. This is a foundational role: there is no existing playbook to inherit, so you'll help design the policies, standards, and operating model that will support ClickHouse's workplace experience as we grow. You'll be responsible for a small but growing footprint of offices across multiple regions, and you'll need to balance our remote-first philosophy with the reality that in-person environments matter — for teams, culture, and moments that are hard to replicate over video.

This role reports to the Head of Procurement and will partner closely with People, IT, Security, Finance, and regional leaders. You should be comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by building something new rather than maintaining something established.

What You Will Do:

• Workplace Function Build-Out: Design and stand up ClickHouse's global workplace function from scratch, including policies, standards, playbooks, and operating processes that can flex across regions and scale as we grow.

• Global Office Operations: Oversee day-to-day operations for ClickHouse's small offices across multiple regions, ensuring a consistent standard of experience while adapting to local norms, labor requirements, and regulations.

• Remote-First, In-Person-Enabled Strategy: Develop a workplace strategy that reflects our remote-first culture while creating high-value in-person environments — team hubs, offsites, and gathering spaces— that strengthen collaboration and connection.

• New Office Setup & Space Planning: Lead site selection, buildout, and launch of new small offices as ClickHouse expands into new regions, in partnership with Procurement, Finance, and Legal.

• Vendor & Facilities Management: Own vendor relationships across regions — broker, landlords, building management, facilities, food and beverage, and events — working closely with Procurement on sourcing and contract negotiation.

• Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with People, IT, Security, and Finance on space planning,

onboarding logistics, workplace technology, and headcount-driven capacity planning across regions.

• Budget Ownership: Own the global workplace budget, track spend across regions, and identify

opportunities to optimize cost without compromising the employee experience.

• Policy & Process Development: Create scalable, well-documented workplace policies — health and safety, visitor management, workplace security, and office access — adaptable across jurisdictions.

• Events & Team Connection: Support company gatherings that reinforce culture and connection across a distributed team.

• Point of Contact & Escalations: Serve as the primary point of contact for office-related issues and emergencies across regions and time zones, establishing clear escalation protocols.

What You'll Bring to the Team:

• 7+ years of experience in workplace, facilities, corporate real estate, or global office operations, ideally including experience building a workplace function or program from the ground up.

• Experience supporting a globally distributed organization with multiple small offices across regions, and an understanding of the operational and regulatory differences that come with that footprint.

• Genuine enthusiasm for remote-first ways of working, paired with an appreciation for why in-person environments matter to teams — and the judgment to know when and how to invest in each.

• Strong vendor management and contract negotiation experience, with comfort partnering closely with a Procurement function.

• Experience managing a budget, with a track record of finding operational efficiencies.

• Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with People, IT, Security, and Finance teams.

• Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating autonomously in a role with significant ownership and limited existing infrastructure.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the cultural fluency to work effectively across regions, time zones, and languages.

• Based in the Americas or EMEA, with the flexibility to travel to regional offices as needed.

Nice to Have:

• Experience negotiating international leases or managing office buildouts outside your home country.

• Familiarity with health, safety, and workplace compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions.

• Experience designing workplace programs specifically for hybrid or remote-first organizations (e.g., home office stipends, co-working allowances, hub-based gathering strategies).

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Global Expenses Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As ClickHouse scales, we're building the technology and operating foundation Finance needs to continue to enable our rapid growth. As part of that work, we're standing up a dedicated Travel & Expense (T&E) function and are looking for a Senior Expense Specialist responsible for maturing the current processes and day-to-day operational excellence.

What You'll Do:

Audit, Compliance & Risk

  • Own expense audit end-to-end

  • Build and maintain the SOX-ready control environment for T&E, including documentation, testing support, and sign-off readiness.

  • Track and reduce policy non-compliance, turning an untracked risk into a measured, managed one.

Global Policy & Program Ownership

  • Enforce one global, regionally compliant T&E policy — including EOR employees — to reduce local tax and audit exposure.

  • Centrally administer and optimize the ClickHouse Expense tool, Corporate Card program and system integrations to the HRIS and ERP systems.

Reimbursement & Employee Experience

  • Cut international reimbursement cycle time from ~30 days to ~7 through automated routing and clear SLAs.

  • Reduce the time employees spend per claim through better tooling, clearer policy, and self-service support.

  • Be the primary point of contact for T&E questions, escalations, and edge cases — approval flow issues, policy setup, and offboarding coordination with the People team

Reporting, Enablement & Change Management

  • Build spend dashboards, KPI tracking, and executive reporting where none exists today.

  • Deliver role-based training and a global T&E champion network, and lead structured change management (ADKAR or similar) to drive adoption of new policy and tools.

  • Partner with Accounting to complete the handoff of remaining T&E responsibilities.

What You Bring Along:

  • 4+ years of experience in travel & expense, accounts payable, or finance operations, ideally at a high-growth or Cloud software company with a distributed, multi-entity employee base.

  • Hands-on ownership of Expensify, Ramp (or a comparable card/expense platform), and NetSuite integrations — you know what breaks in these systems and how to fix it at the root, not just route the ticket.

  • Working knowledge of SOX controls and audit readiness for expense and card programs; experience building or maintaining automated fraud detection a plus.

  • Comfort designing policy for a global, multi-entity, multi-employment-type workforce (FTE and EOR, including platforms like Deel), and translating that policy into system configuration.

  • A track record of building reporting and KPI visibility from scratch — you don't wait for a dashboard to be handed to you, you build it.

  • Experience running training and change management for a process or tool rollout (ADKAR or similar frameworks a plus).

  • Ownership mentality: you see a broken process and fix the root cause, not just the ticket in front of you.

  • Independence: you troubleshoot issues, ask clarifying questions, and propose solutions rather than escalating every ambiguity.

  • Curiosity: you ask why a process exists before you automate it, and you're a lifelong learner when it comes to new systems.

  • Follow-through: you see initiatives through to full adoption, not just launch.

#LI-remote

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, Partner Integrations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and $250M ARR, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We're hiring a Product Manager to own partner integrations at ClickHouse. This role owns how ClickHouse shows up inside the platforms our customers already use: embedded, native experiences across the hyperscalers and developer platforms, and deeper technical integrations with strategic partners like dbt, Fivetran, Hex, and Sigma. There is a growing surface of partner work already in motion, and this role shapes where we invest in co-innovation opportunities.

This is one of the most cross-functional roles at ClickHouse. You'll work across multiple engineering teams, our partnerships and solutions teams, and the partners themselves to deliver meaningful co-innovation and integrations with complementary technologies. You'll own the technical side of our House Mates partner program and be the person who navigates the multi-org reality of getting an integration certified, listed, and live. This is a hands-on role: you'll write the specs, run the partner calls, drive certification processes, and coordinate across teams to get things over the line.

You Will

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ClickHouse's Cloud integrations with strategic partners

  • Seek out complementary innovation opportunities with partners. Define what a "better together" integration looks like with each strategic partner, and drive it from joint roadmap through launch.

  • Navigate the trade-offs of embedded integrations: billing and metering, identity and auth, security and data residency, and coordination across ClickHouse and partner teams.

  • Project-manage complex, multi-org launches: marketplace listings, certification processes, partner co-marketing, and GA timelines across multiple organizations.

  • Own the technical standards and certification criteria for integrations submitted through the House Mates partner program.

  • Measure and communicate co-innovation business impact, adoption and product strategy to executive leadership.

  • Represent ClickHouse externally at partner events and in joint content.

You Bring

  • Experience shipping integrations into third-party platforms before: hyperscaler marketplaces, embedded or native integrations, ISV partnerships, or OEM/white-label work.

  • An understanding of the trade-offs that make or break a partner integration, billing, auth, security, cross-team dependencies, and have made those decisions in the past.

  • A strong project management lens and are comfortable owning a launch that depends on five teams across two companies.

  • Patience and resilience with partners who are unresponsive or have their own competing priorities, and you find creative ways to keep things moving anyway.

  • Technical ability to understand an integration end to end, from provisioning and auth to billing and data flow, and to hold a credible conversation with engineers about APIs, architecture, and technical trade-offs.

  • Energy and excitement for external-facing work: partner calls, customer conversations, and representing the product publicly.

  • Hands-on and high ownership ability. You write the specs, run the partner calls, and stay close to the details.

  • Comfort in ambiguity and fast-moving environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building partner integrations with hyperscalers and modern technology companies.

  • Experience running or supporting a technology partner program.

  • Background at a database or data infrastructure company; familiarity with ClickHouse or peers like Snowflake, BigQuery, or Databricks.

  • Experience working in remote, multi-timezone environments.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Accountant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and $250M ARR, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

 

The company's sustained, accelerating momentum was recently validated by a $400M Series D financing round. Over the past three months, customers including Capital One, Lovable, Decagon, Polymarket, and Airwallex have adopted the platform or expanded existing deployments. These customers join an established base of AI innovators and global brands such as Meta, Cursor, Sony, and Tesla.

 

We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Accountant to join our revenue accounting team. You will report to the Director of Order to Cash and Revenue Accounting and be responsible for executing the month-end close cycle for revenue recognition, including reconciliations for revenue and deferred revenue, reviewing customer contracts, and preparing financial reporting metrics such as RPO. You'll work cross-functionally with AR & Billing, Legal, Sales Operations, FP&A, and Data teams to build scalable, automated revenue processes.

You Will

  • Own the end-to-end monthly revenue close, preparing journal entries, reconciliations, and flux analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, and contract asset balances.

  • Prepare the deferred revenue waterfall and financial reporting metrics.

  • Reconcile consumption data to billing and revenue; use SQL/data queries and AI tools to assist and automate the work.

  • Review customer contracts and order forms under ASC 606, and prepare accounting checklist for complex or non-standard deals.

  • Prepare estimate calculations, including the standalone selling price (SSP) analyses.

  • Support new product introductions (NPI), new pricing models, SKU launches, and system upgrades or implementations.

  • Support external audits and manage PBC requests related to revenue.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with AR & Billing, Legal, Sales Operations, FP&A, and Data teams to improve the quote-to-revenue workflow.

You Bring

  • 3+ years of progressive accounting experience with a focus on revenue accounting, ideally at a SaaS or consumption-based technology company.

  • Strong working knowledge of ASC 606, including contract review, SSP, and revenue disclosures (deferred revenue, RPO).

  • Experience with NetSuite, Stripe, and Salesforce, and familiarity with the integrations and data flows among these systems; experience with cloud marketplace billing (AWS, GCP, Azure) is a plus.

  • Comfort working with large data sets; SQL or similar query skills, and an interest in using AI and automation to streamline processes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex contracts and data sets.

  • A quick learner with excellent attention to detail, organization, and communication skills; able to collaborate cross-functionally and explain revenue matters clearly.

  • CPA (or equivalent) and/or Big Four public accounting experience preferred.

  • Experience supporting audits, internal controls, and SOX readiness preferred.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is seeking a highly organised, resourceful, and proactive Executive Assistant (EA) to provide strategic and operational support to our 'VP EMEA Sales' and 'RVP EMEA Solutions Architecture'. This role is pivotal in ensuring both leaders are effective, focused, and operating at their highest capacity. You will serve as a trusted partner—anticipating needs, managing complex priorities, and enabling seamless coordination across teams.

What you will do:

  • Executive Support

    • Support local leadership through complex calendar management, scheduling, and prioritisation, balancing internal and external commitments across multiple time zones.

    • Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics for domestic and international engagements, with a focus on APAC region support.

    • Prepare materials, agendas, meeting notes, and follow-up actions for leadership meetings, offsites, customer engagements, and key business events.

    Cross-Functional Coordination

    • Facilitate effective communication and information flow across Sales, Revenue, and other cross-functional teams.

    • Track action items, deadlines, and key deliverables, ensuring leaders are prepared and aligned on priorities.

    • Draft, review, and edit executive communications, presentations, reports, and other business materials.

    • Serve as a trusted liaison between leadership and internal stakeholders, customers, partners, and external contacts.

    Confidentiality & Judgment

    • Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

    • Exercise sound judgment when prioritising competing requests, managing escalations, and navigating fast-paced business environments.

About you:

  • 5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-level executives, preferably across sales, product, or marketing functions.

  • Exceptional organisational and time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a polished executive presence.

  • Tech-savvy with proficiency in productivity tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, project management platforms such as Asana or Monday.com).

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager Architect - Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Technical Account Manager ("TAM") Architect role will be a member of our Support Services team and Support group, planned to report into our regional Support Engineering Managers. This new role will perform functions that our existing team already provides in part: ongoing TAM, Consultative, and Support functions working with a set of customers providing Consultative Support, Escalation insights, and oversight. TAM Architects will also be assisting with Support Cases for enterprise customers in an L3 role (Support Level 3 = Escalated cases).

Note: We are hiring for this role in Japan. There will be on-site travel to provide in-person support to customers in Tokyo.

A TAM Architect will be successful in the role if they provide the following aptitude and approach:

  • Highly technical with a focus on providing useful solutions to our users, customers, and prospects

  • Great communicator with team members and customers

  • Consulting, support, and project management skills and background

  • 50% of the work will be case-initiated consultative support of strategic users/customers/prospects

  • 50% of the work will be TAM functions (project guidance, onboarding coordination, escalations, communications, documentation, roadmap, meeting leadership)

  • Some onsite regional travel will be required, estimated currently at up to 35% of the time

What you will do:

  • Work with strategic and enterprise ClickHouse users, customers, and prospects as identified by ClickHouse Sales to work on onboarding, production launches, and POCs

  • Provide architectural, technical, and migration guidance and assistance

  • Lead projects, escalations, and meetings to enable ongoing user/customer success

  • Ownership and oversight of L3 Support Cases and Escalations, working closely with the Support L1/L2 team

  • Partner closely with ClickHouse Product Management, Engineering, and Sales to help develop the roadmap and account plans

  • Be present and available according to the scheduling and onsite travel required to deliver high-quality 24x7 Support in a global, distributed environment

  • Assist with hiring and mentoring new team members

  • Develop and assist with Docs, Knowledge Base articles, ClickHouse Learning, Reference Architecture, and QA needs

What you bring along:

  • 5+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Senior Support, and/or Project Management roles

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience in implementing, operating, and/or supporting operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed database management systems ("DBMS")

  • Technical breadth and depth in relevant subjects such as DBMS, OLAP, Cloud/SaaS platforms, distributed systems software engineering, Linux/Unix, Kubernetes, System or Network Administration, and big data

  • Experience leading and shipping large scope technical projects in collaboration with multiple experienced engineers.

  • Expertise with a public cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) and their infrastructure as a service offering (e.g. EC2).

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a customer-facing role and in close collaboration with the Support Services, Engineering, and Sales teams

  • A mindset of teamwork, global engagement, empathy, and solving challenging problems

  • A sense of adventure and urgency in building the most scalable, highest performing, largest, and fastest databases on the planet

  • Self-driven, curious, and eager to continuously learn and grow

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

jobs.title: テクニカルアカウントマネージャー アーキテクト - 日本
jobs.descriptionHtml:
テクニカルアカウントマネージャー(「TAM」)アーキテクトは、サポートサービスチームおよびサポートグループのメンバーとして、地域のサポートエンジニアリングマネージャーの配下に置かれる予定です。この新しい役職は、既存チームが一部担っている機能を遂行します。具体的には、コンサルティングサポート、エスカレーション対応の洞察、監督といった機能を、複数の顧客に対して継続的にTAM業務、コンサルティング業務、サポート業務として提供します。TAMアーキテクトはまた、エンタープライズ顧客のサポートケースにL3(サポートレベル3=エスカレーション対応)として対応します。

注:本ポジションは日本での採用となります。東京の顧客に対面でサポートを提供するための出張が発生します。

TAMアーキテクトとして成功するためには、以下の適性とアプローチが求められます:

  • 高い技術力を持ち、ユーザー、顧客、見込み客に有用なソリューションを提供することに重点を置いていること

  • チームメンバーおよび顧客との優れたコミュニケーション能力

  • コンサルティング、サポート、プロジェクトマネジメントのスキルと経験

  • 業務の50%は、戦略的ユーザー/顧客/見込み客からのケースベースのコンサルティングサポート

  • 業務の50%はTAM業務(プロジェクトガイダンス、オンボーディング調整、エスカレーション対応、コミュニケーション、ドキュメント作成、ロードマップ、会議のリード)

  • 現地での出張が一部必要であり、現時点では最大で業務時間の35%程度と想定されています

業務内容:

  • ClickHouseセールスが特定した戦略的・エンタープライズのClickHouseユーザー、顧客、見込み客と協力し、オンボーディング、本番環境へのローンチ、POC(概念実証)に取り組む

  • アーキテクチャ、技術、移行に関するガイダンスと支援を提供する

  • ユーザー/顧客の継続的な成功を実現するため、プロジェクト、エスカレーション、会議をリードする

  • L3サポートケースおよびエスカレーションの責任と監督を担い、サポートL1/L2チームと緊密に連携する

  • ClickHouseのプロダクトマネジメント、エンジニアリング、セールスと緊密に連携し、ロードマップおよびアカウントプランの策定を支援する

  • グローバルかつ分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要なスケジュールおよび出張に対応し、常に対応可能な状態を維持する

  • 新しいチームメンバーの採用およびメンタリングを支援する

  • ドキュメント、ナレッジベース記事、ClickHouse Learning、リファレンスアーキテクチャ、QA(品質保証)ニーズの開発・支援を行う

求める経験・スキル:

  • テクニカルアカウントマネジメント、プロフェッショナルサービス、シニアサポート、および/またはプロジェクトマネジメントの職務における5年以上の経験

  • スケーラブルかつフォールトトレラントな分散型データベース管理システム(「DBMS」)の実装、運用、および/またはサポートにおける5年以上の関連業界経験

  • DBMS、OLAP、クラウド/SaaSプラットフォーム、分散システムのソフトウェアエンジニアリング、Linux/Unix、Kubernetes、システムまたはネットワーク管理、ビッグデータなど、関連分野における広範かつ深い技術知識

  • 複数の経験豊富なエンジニアと連携し、大規模な技術プロジェクトをリードし完遂した経験

  • パブリッククラウドプロバイダー(AWS、GCP、Azure)およびそのIaaS(Infrastructure as a Service)サービス(例:EC2)に関する専門知識

  • 優れたコミュニケーション能力、および顧客対応の役割においてサポートサービス、エンジニアリング、セールスチームと緊密に協働する能力

  • チームワーク、グローバルな関与、共感、そして困難な課題を解決するマインドセット

  • 地球上で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能を持ち、最大規模かつ最速のデータベースを構築することへの冒険心と当事者意識

  • 自発的で、探究心があり、継続的に学び成長することに意欲的であること

訳語の確認・注記:

  • TAM (Technical Account Manager) と L3 (Support Level 3) は業界標準の略称としてそのまま保持しました(日本語の技術業界でもTAM/L1・L2・L3という表記が一般的です)。

  • POC は「概念実証」と補足しましたが、業界では英語表記のまま使われることも多いため、必要であれば「POC」のみに戻せます。

  • IaaS も同様に、EC2の例と合わせて分かりやすくするため展開して記載しました。

  • 会社名「ClickHouse」、サービス名「ClickHouse Learning」は固有名詞としてそのまま英語表記を維持しています。

必要であれば、より簡潔な社内向けトーンや、より厳密な求人サイト向けのフォーマルなトーンに調整することも可能です。

Perks

テクニカルアカウントマネージャー(「TAM」)アーキテクトは、サポートサービスチームおよびサポートグループのメンバーとして、地域のサポートエンジニアリングマネージャーの配下に置かれる予定です。この新しい役職は、既存チームが一部担っている機能を遂行します。具体的には、コンサルティングサポート、エスカレーション対応の洞察、監督といった機能を、複数の顧客に対して継続的にTAM業務、コンサルティング業務、サポート業務として提供します。TAMアーキテクトはまた、エンタープライズ顧客のサポートケースにL3(サポートレベル3=エスカレーション対応)として対応します。

注:本ポジションは日本での採用となります。東京の顧客に対面でサポートを提供するための出張が発生します。

TAMアーキテクトとして成功するためには、以下の適性とアプローチが求められます:

 - 高い技術力を持ち、ユーザー、顧客、見込み客に有用なソリューションを提供することに重点を置いていること

 - チームメンバーおよび顧客との優れたコミュニケーション能力

 - コンサルティング、サポート、プロジェクトマネジメントのスキルと経験

 - 業務の50%は、戦略的ユーザー/顧客/見込み客からのケースベースのコンサルティングサポート

 - 業務の50%はTAM業務(プロジェクトガイダンス、オンボーディング調整、エスカレーション対応、コミュニケーション、ドキュメント作成、ロードマップ、会議のリード)

 - 現地での出張が一部必要であり、現時点では最大で業務時間の35%程度と想定されています

業務内容:

 - ClickHouseセールスが特定した戦略的・エンタープライズのClickHouseユーザー、顧客、見込み客と協力し、オンボーディング、本番環境へのローンチ、POC(概念実証)に取り組む

 - アーキテクチャ、技術、移行に関するガイダンスと支援を提供する

 - ユーザー/顧客の継続的な成功を実現するため、プロジェクト、エスカレーション、会議をリードする

 - L3サポートケースおよびエスカレーションの責任と監督を担い、サポートL1/L2チームと緊密に連携する

 - ClickHouseのプロダクトマネジメント、エンジニアリング、セールスと緊密に連携し、ロードマップおよびアカウントプランの策定を支援する

 - グローバルかつ分散した環境で高品質な24時間365日のサポートを提供するために必要なスケジュールおよび出張に対応し、常に対応可能な状態を維持する

 - 新しいチームメンバーの採用およびメンタリングを支援する

 - ドキュメント、ナレッジベース記事、ClickHouse Learning、リファレンスアーキテクチャ、QA(品質保証)ニーズの開発・支援を行う

求める経験・スキル:

 - テクニカルアカウントマネジメント、プロフェッショナルサービス、シニアサポート、および/またはプロジェクトマネジメントの職務における5年以上の経験

 - スケーラブルかつフォールトトレラントな分散型データベース管理システム(「DBMS」)の実装、運用、および/またはサポートにおける5年以上の関連業界経験

 - DBMS、OLAP、クラウド/SaaSプラットフォーム、分散システムのソフトウェアエンジニアリング、Linux/Unix、Kubernetes、システムまたはネットワーク管理、ビッグデータなど、関連分野における広範かつ深い技術知識

 - 複数の経験豊富なエンジニアと連携し、大規模な技術プロジェクトをリードし完遂した経験

 - パブリッククラウドプロバイダー(AWS、GCP、Azure)およびそのIaaS(Infrastructure as a Service)サービス(例:EC2)に関する専門知識

 - 優れたコミュニケーション能力、および顧客対応の役割においてサポートサービス、エンジニアリング、セールスチームと緊密に協働する能力

 - チームワーク、グローバルな関与、共感、そして困難な課題を解決するマインドセット

 - 地球上で最もスケーラブルで、最高性能を持ち、最大規模かつ最速のデータベースを構築することへの冒険心と当事者意識

 - 自発的で、探究心があり、継続的に学び成長することに意欲的であること

訳語の確認・注記:

 - TAM (Technical Account Manager) と L3 (Support Level 3) は業界標準の略称としてそのまま保持しました(日本語の技術業界でもTAM/L1・L2・L3という表記が一般的です)。

 - POC は「概念実証」と補足しましたが、業界では英語表記のまま使われることも多いため、必要であれば「POC」のみに戻せます。

 - IaaS も同様に、EC2の例と合わせて分かりやすくするため展開して記載しました。

 - 会社名「ClickHouse」、サービス名「ClickHouse Learning」は固有名詞としてそのまま英語表記を維持しています。

必要であれば、より簡潔な社内向けトーンや、より厳密な求人サイト向けのフォーマルなトーンに調整することも可能です。


PERKS

 - Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

 - Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

 - Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

 - Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

 - A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

 - Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

jobs.title: Growth Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ClickHouse is looking for Growth Engineers who are obsessed with both craft UI and agentic experiences. You care about the button, the empty state, and the agent that helps someone get unstuck, and you care equally about whether any of it moved the number.

You’ll join our growth pod to build experimentation infrastructure, onboarding flows, and product surfaces across the self-serve funnel: classic human UI and AI-assisted / agent-driven flows. You’ll work side by side with unified console engineers, but your mandate is speed and impact: ship something testable, measure it, and iterate. You’re motivated by moving a number and learning fast, more than by getting every detail right on the first try.

This is a new role at ClickHouse. You’ll help define what growth engineering looks like here: PLG experimentation that spans human and agentic experiences. You’ll work closely with product, design, and data science on one pod, and partner with unified console and app teams on shared product surfaces.

What you will do:

  • Build and ship experiments across the self-serve funnel: signup, onboarding, activation, and monetization flows.

  • Design and polish human UI (flows, forms, empty states, navigation, microcopy surfaces) with a high bar for clarity and conversion.

  • Design and ship agentic experiences (AI-assisted onboarding, in-product agents, guided workflows) that help users reach value faster.

  • Run disciplined experiments on both: hypothesis, instrumentation, ship, learn. Tools like GrowthBook are part of the day-to-day.

  • Partner closely with product, design, and data science to go from idea to shipped experiment quickly.

  • Work within the Cloud Console codebase alongside unified console engineers, and partner with app teams (including Observability, Agents, and Postgres) on strong end-to-end user flows.

  • Obsess over metrics: acquisition, activation, and monetization. You want proof that what you shipped moved the needle.

Requirements:

  • Experienced in full-stack product engineering (TypeScript / Node / React), ideally including time on a growth, product, or experimentation-focused team.

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, and React, with real taste for product UI.

  • Experience building with LLMs or agent patterns in a product (tool calling, streaming, evals, system/prompt design), or a clear track record of shipping AI features you measured and iterated on.

  • Comfortable shipping a smaller, testable version of an idea first, then iterating based on what you learn.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs and JSON.

  • Experience with experimentation or A/B testing tools (e.g. GrowthBook, Optimizely, LaunchDarkly), or strong interest in building that muscle.

  • Proficient with Git and collaborative code review.

  • Excellent communication skills. You’ll work daily with PM, design, data science, marketing, and other engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • You’ve shipped both polished UI experiments and agentic / AI-assisted product experiences (not just prototypes), with instrumentation and iteration.

  • Experience on a growth or product-led-growth team, ideally at a company with a self-serve funnel.

  • Experience with ClickHouse or other data-intensive/analytics products.

  • Familiarity with Auth0 or similar auth integrations.

  • Experience working closely with (but not necessarily reporting into) a separate platform or infrastructure engineering team.

  • You have opinions on what makes great human UX and great agent UX, and you use AI heavily in your own workflow.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Team

The ClickPipes team builds the services that power data ingestion into ClickHouse Cloud. As a primary entry point for customers’ data, ClickPipes is critical to product adoption and the company’s growth. We work at petabyte scale, solving challenges in distributed systems, fault tolerance, and high-throughput ingestion. You’ll help make these pipelines performant, reliable, and easy to operate, with ownership of technical decisions and the platform as a whole.

You can find some of the team’s recent work highlighted in our blog:

  • GCP Pub/Sub connector for ClickPipes is now in Private Preview

  • Terraform & OpenAPI for ClickPipes is now Generally Available

  • Unordered mode for GCS ClickPipes is now available

We’re looking for backend engineers with experience in data-intensive systems who enjoy working across technologies. You’ll collaborate with engineering and product partners and drive projects from design through production.

What will you do?

  • Build and evolve integrations with streaming platforms and object storage, including Kafka, Kinesis, Pub/Sub, S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage.

  • Continuously improve our systems based on operational metrics, customer feedback, and evolving business requirements.

  • Drive technical discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that impact our platform's scalability and resilience.

  • Participate in on-call rotations to ensure system reliability and respond to production incidents.

About you:

  • 5+ years of software development experience building and operating distributed systems.

  • Strong knowledge of Go and its ecosystem.

  • Experience designing systems for scalability and fault tolerance, with an understanding of concurrency, consistency, and failure recovery.

  • Understanding of cloud-native architecture and practical experience with at least one major cloud provider.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving production issues in distributed systems.

  • Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate across engineering and product teams.

  • Experience with data ingestion pipelines, streaming platforms, or object storage is a plus.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.
